openDecisions.question: Source of localized city names for «Київ · UTC+02:00» labels and search (Intl has none: Intl.DisplayNames throws for type timeZone, longGeneric gives metazone text «за східноєвропейським часом»)
options: A: generated feature-local map from CLDR 48.2 exemplarCity (uk covers all 418 zones, en 95 overrides + id-derived fallback), about 18 KB, loaded only by the settings section
B: 418 keys per locale in messages/*.json (ships on every page: layout.tsx NextIntlClientProvider has no messages prop)
C: curated subset of popular cities in messages, IANA segment for the rest (uk search misses most cities)
D: no localized names, IANA city segment + offset (fails «Київ» query)
openDecisions.recommendation: A. Only option that satisfies the four-query Kyiv row in both locales without shipping the catalog app-wide. Index both uk and en names regardless of UI locale so «Київ» works on /en. Provenance (CLDR version, extraction command) goes in the PR body, since code comments are banned.
openDecisions.answer: A: CLDR 48.2 generated map inside the feature, uk + en, search across both locales

openDecisions.question: How to apply exact > prefix > partial ordering in the cmdk list
options: A: Command shouldFilter={false}, pure rankTimezones(query, options) in model, render its result
B: cmdk filter prop returning tiered scores (1 / 0.66 / 0.33 / 0), cmdk reorders DOM
openDecisions.recommendation: A. Deterministic, unit-testable without a DOM, and order within a tier stays under our control. With shouldFilter off the active item must be reset to the first result on query change (controlled value), otherwise Enter can confirm a stale item.
openDecisions.answer: A: shouldFilter={false} with a pure ranking function; active item resets to the first on query change

openDecisions.question: Keep or narrow the invalidation after timezone / weekStartDay saves
options: A: keep (invalidate every non-settings query, settings-change-effects.ts:19-23)
B: narrow weekStartDay-only saves to statistics + delivery + home through three new domain effects functions; keep broad for timezone
openDecisions.recommendation: A. Timezone is read by 34 API service files across books, delivery, genres, home, loans, notes, quotes, reading-goals, reading-queue, series and statistics (UserSettingsContextService), so narrowing it saves nothing. For weekStartDay the narrowed set is small but needs three cross-feature effects modules (CLAUDE.md §2) for a rare action, and invalidateQueries refetches only active queries by default, which on /settings is next to none.
openDecisions.answer: Keep the current broad invalidation; not narrowed

openDecisions.question: Same field changed again while its own save is pending or queued
options: A: lock that control (aria-disabled + early return), as the switches and stepper do now (notification-settings-section.tsx:119, 164)
B: allow and queue a second mutation for the same field
openDecisions.recommendation: A. useMutation keeps callbacks only for its latest call (mutationObserver.ts:128-142), so B needs extra bookkeeping to roll back the right value; the spec only requires different fields to queue. Timezone and week start currently lack the guard (regional-settings-section.tsx:136-146, 181-190).
openDecisions.answer: Lock the field control while its own save is pending or queued

openDecisions.question: Sonner toasts on settings save success/error
options: A: remove; inline Збереження… / error + live region only
B: keep toasts in addition
openDecisions.recommendation: A. The spec defines inline feedback plus a live region; a toast doubles the announcement and a success toast per switch is noise on autosave.
openDecisions.answer: Inline only: no toasts on settings saves; inline saving/error state with retry and a live region

openDecisions.question: Where the test-notification result shows
options: A: inline status under the button (role=status), retry button on error
B: toasts as today (notification-settings-section.tsx:204-207)
openDecisions.recommendation: A. 429 and retry must stay visible and actionable; a toast disappears and cannot host the retry reliably.
openDecisions.answer: Inline status under the test button with retry on error; no toast

openDecisions.question: Page description under H1 (settings.page.description mentions only email and timezone)
options: A: keep and rewrite to cover reminders and calendar
B: drop it, cards directly under the title
openDecisions.recommendation: A. Other app pages use the title + description header; rewrite to one line that also covers the calendar.
openDecisions.answer: Keep the H1 description and rewrite it to cover reminders and the calendar

openDecisions.question: Form of the empty-202 fix in http-client
options: A: read text once, return undefined when empty, JSON.parse otherwise, for every ok status
B: add 202 to the 204 special case
openDecisions.recommendation: A. Covers any future empty 2xx and keeps one rule on both paths (:62-64, :136-137). B is smaller but breaks the day a 202 carries a body. Before coding, main loop confirms the bug live: curl -i POST /api/notifications/test shows Content-Length: 0 and the current UI shows the error toast.
openDecisions.answer: A: read the body as text, empty body resolves undefined, otherwise JSON.parse, for every 2xx
